scope: Desktop host tests of the platform-independent C UART stream framer; no STM32 board, DMA or real UART link

design.resync_rule: bad version / payload_len > 128 / CRC mismatch discards one byte and rescans buffered bytes (same as vision/runtime/protocol.py StreamDecoder)
design.idle_flush: ss_stream_idle() releases a real frame held behind a false SS header when the line goes idle
design.difference_from_python: CRC-valid frames with an unknown message type are delivered so the controller can reply; Python drops them

test_cases: every chunk size 1..26 for a vision result frame
three back-to-back frames including a 128-byte payload in one feed
noise with lone/odd magic, wrong version and oversized lengths, then valid frame
CRC-corrupted frame followed by valid frame
false header (len 128) hiding a real frame: recovered by idle flush, or by padding
reset of a partial frame, NULL arguments, NULL handler
200 random frames (types 1-9, payload 0-128) with S-heavy noise and random 1-64 byte chunks; buffer always < 136
fragmented noisy vision result fed through the stream into sort_controller_accept_frame: fields decoded, state MOVE_TO_TARGET

python_parity_check.method: ad-hoc scratch script: same 258115-byte noisy stream (3000 frame slots, 5% bit-flipped frames) decoded by Python StreamDecoder and the C framer with different random chunking
python_parity_check.note: Not a substitute for I-02 full field-level C/Python interoperability

not_covered: STM32 DMA/interrupt wiring and IDLE detection timing (S-04)
Real cable noise while motors run (U-09)
